_comment: When a medal is awarded. The C holds none: the rows start unused and the build writes these (at most 20); a medal with no row here is never awarded by the game itself (the story can still award it). when = [kind, numbers]: allTriggers [first, count] all set; wins [n] tournament wins >= n; allCards [trigger, end] every real authored card below the id `end` owned (0: every card) and that trigger set (-1: none); allMoves [n] the first n techniques learned; stats [hpMp, others] all six base stats at least; money [n] exactly; year [n] exactly; allRaised [first, end] the species first..end-1 raised once; fish [n] caught >= n; allPartners [] every species a partner can be raised once; residents [originals] every city resident recruited (1: only the original game's fifty). needs: the OPTIONS switch the row waits for (newDigimon, newCards, extendedStory); hiddenWithout: the medal is not shown while that switch is off. checkedBy: tick = every tamer tick, script = the card-trader routine (the textbox shown is `text`). levelUp raises the tamer level.

medals.note: all six cups D, C, B, A, S, R won (triggers 15-20)
the seven attribute cups, Fire to Filth (triggers 26-32)
Classic Master: every partner species of the original game (1..61) raised once; the tamer level goes up
Classic Peak: all six base stats at the original maximum, HP and MP 9999, the rest 999
Classic City: the fifty residents of the original game all live in the city
Classic Collection: every card of the original game
every card of the original game and the game beaten once (trigger 50), for the card trader
Horizon Master: every species a partner can be, the new ones included, raised once
Limit Breaker: past the original maximum, HP and MP 15000 and the rest 1500
Horizon City: every resident lives in the city, the extended story's included
Full Collection: every card, the new ones included
